from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import json
import sys

class DebugAPIHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        content_length = int(self.headers['Content-Length'])
        post_data = self.rfile.read(content_length)
        data = json.loads(post_data)
        
        if self.path == '/checkpoint':
            line = data.get('line', 0)
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            response = {
                "status": "success", 
                "message": f"Checkpoint at line {line}: Program state as expected."
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response).encode())
        elif self.path == '/fix':
            line = data.get('line', 0)
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            response = {
                "status": "success",
                "message": f"Attempt to fix bug at line {line}. Bug will be fixed if present."
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(response).encode())
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
    
    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # Suppress log messages
        pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 8008
    server = HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), DebugAPIHandler)
    print(f"Starting server on port {port}...")
    server.serve_forever()
